# SpriteBatchExtensions

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Graphics` · class

```csharp
public static class SpriteBatchExtensions
```

Toolkit extension methods that let [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md) draw [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md) values (texture regions, trimmed atlas sprites, etc.) by translating them into the framework's [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md)-plus-rectangle primitive.

## Methods

### AsSource

```csharp
public static ITextureSource AsSource(this Texture texture)
```

Types: [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md), [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md)

Wraps a plain [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md) as an [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md) covering the whole texture. This allocates on every call, so keep the result rather than calling it each frame.

### Draw

```csharp
public static void Draw(this SpriteBatch spriteBatch, ITextureSource source, Vector2 position, Color color, Angle rotation = default, Vector2 origin = default, Vector2? scale = null, Rectangle? sourceRectangle = null, SpriteFlip flip = SpriteFlip.None)
```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md), [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md), [`Angle`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Angle.md), [`Rectangle`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Rectangle.md), [`SpriteFlip`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteFlip.md)

Queues a texture source, or a part of it, to be drawn during this batch.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `source` | The texture source to draw. May be a plain [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md) (via [`AsSource`](#assource)), a trimmed atlas region, or any other [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md). When the source is trimmed, only its [`ITextureSource.PackedFrame`](ITextureSource.md#packedframe) is drawn and the origin is adjusted so the pivot lands at the same logical pixel regardless of trimming. |
| `origin` | The point the source is positioned, rotated and scaled about, in its logical (untrimmed) pixels from its top-left corner. |
| `scale` | The scale along each axis, or `null` for none. A negative component mirrors the source about `origin`, trimmed or not. |
| `sourceRectangle` | A sub-rectangle to draw, or `null` to draw the entire source (trim-aware). When `source` is a trimmed region, this rectangle is interpreted in the source's logical coordinate space and is translated to the underlying GPU texture's coordinates, and only its part inside the trimmed frame is drawn. With a sub-rectangle, `origin` is relative to the sub-rectangle's top-left corner. |
| `flip` | Mirrors the image inside its logical (untrimmed) rectangle, which doesn't move: it flips in place whatever the origin, and a trimmed source's pixels land mirrored where they belong. |
| `spriteBatch` | The batch to draw into. |
| `position` | Where the source's origin is drawn. |
| `color` | The tint its colors are multiplied by. |
| `rotation` | The rotation about the origin. |

[`SpriteBatch.Begin`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md#begin) must be called before this method.

```csharp
public static void Draw(this SpriteBatch spriteBatch, TextureRegion region, Vector2 position, Color color, Angle rotation = default, Vector2 origin = default, Vector2? scale = null, SpriteFlip flip = SpriteFlip.None)
```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`TextureRegion`](TextureRegion.md), [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md), [`Angle`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Angle.md), [`SpriteFlip`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteFlip.md)

Draws a region of a texture, trim-aware, as the [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md) overload does, without an interface call per property: for particles and other sprites by the thousand. Its parameters, the flip among them, are as that overload's.
